events.title: POST FUN with Sadie Skinner & Caribou Run
events.description: Postfun: Halifax indie band Postfun is touring the Maritimes to promote their latest EP, “Hunting Music”. Seamlessly melding midwest emo, post-hardcore, and alt-country with distinct Maritime authenticity, Postfun revels in delivering infectious live energy, a love for storytelling, and unconventional takes on indie rock conventions. Caribou Run: Caribou Run is a 6-piece neofolk band based in Mahone Bay NS. Their songs are catchy and anthemic with lyrics that provoke emotion and thought in the listener. Their live performance is a dynamic experience that is a roller coaster of sing alongs…
